key_insight: Logical noise can be transformed into a controlled resource in quantum information processing.
engineering_relevance: This approach enhances the programmability of dissipation in fault-tolerant quantum architectures.
method: Utilize a programmable error-correction cycle to create logical channels.
Encode dissipation into effective logical dynamics without additional ancilla qubits.
Employ decoder/recovery randomization for generating a family of logical channels.
evidence_signal: The approach allows for controlled mixtures of logical channels that simulate target dissipators directly.
watch_item: The method's effectiveness hinges on maintaining low uncontrolled logical errors during dissipation processes.
paper_title: Programmable Dissipation via Partial Quantum Error Correction
